review.method: Page-by-page audit against every preserved source scan. Terms are categorized as explicitly printed lesson vocabulary, additional contextual words, or functional expressions; each has an Arabic learner-support gloss and exact source-image allocation. Original scans remain available alongside typed study notes.
review.translationNote: Arabic meanings are age-appropriate editorial learner-support glosses, not translations printed in the textbook.
review.scopeNote: Character names, ordinary articles and pronouns except where part of a useful expression, isolated numerals, picture-only labels, and blank dotted answer lines are excluded. Workbook Revision 1 is included as printed content on its assigned images. Listening-only content is not transcribed or keyed because no audio/transcript was supplied.
